name: cn.dianyinhuoban.hm.mvp.order.OrderDetailActivity
description: The Dianyin Guanjia Hongmeng Edition (电银管家泓盟版) SDK from holderman has a screen that loads a selected machine-application order and shows its shipping and status details, with actions to confirm receipt or call the company.
disableEffect: Users will lose order details and the receipt-confirmation action.
